# Final hardening acceptance matrix

Prepared before implementation on 2026-09-12. Expected outcomes are independently specified from the supported syntax contract; they are not generated by the production parsers.

The executable case manifest is [`acceptance-cases.json`](acceptance-cases.json). The
canonical child runner is `tests/run_acceptance.py`; its case records carry the
hand-authored assertion string and are accepted only when
`tests/validate_acceptance.py` validates the complete result.
It freezes four exact fixture files and SHA-256 values, pinned oracle metadata,
independent classifications, inventory expectations, write/refusal behavior,
exit codes, positive controls and scope. The normal suite validates that the
manifest is complete and that no current test generator silently rewrites it.

## Doctor Markdown visibility

| Case family | Expected visibility | Expected checks/exit |
|---|---|---|
| One or more same-line nested list markers before a fence, authentic wiring block | Hidden as quoted example | wiring-block FAIL, clauses/path SKIP, exit 2 |
| One or more same-line nested markers, visible unfenced authentic block | Visible | all wiring checks PASS, normal clean-register advisory only |
| Mixed bullet/ordered containers with valid blank/tight boundaries | Visible when block is active; hidden when fenced/indented | checks follow visibility |
| Indentation and tab stops at container content columns | CommonMark-relative: active or hidden by code threshold | checks follow visibility |
| Blank versus tight list boundaries and lazy paragraph continuation | Blank starts nested container; lazy paragraph remains active | checks follow parser contract |
| Matching fence marker/length | Fence closes and later active text is visible | active checks resume |
| Mismatched marker or shorter fence | Fence remains open | content remains hidden |
| Active text after a valid closure | Visible | wiring checks can pass |

|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `doctor-a1`, `doctor-a2` | Exact source fixture and CommonMark classification in manifest; hidden code block | Wiring hidden | Read-only Doctor rejection / 2 | `doctor-a1-positive`, `doctor-a2-positive` fixture controls | supported negative controls |
| `migration-split-cdata` | Exact source fixture; non-contiguous `]]` + `>` remains opaque | No phantom mapping; one unresolved record | Refuse before journal / 2 | contiguous terminator in migration suite | supported boundary |
| `migration-split-pi` | Exact source fixture; non-contiguous `?` + `>` remains opaque | No phantom mapping; one unresolved record | Refuse before journal / 2 | contiguous terminator in migration suite | supported boundary |

## Migration opaque HTML visibility

| Case family | Expected inventory | Expected write/refusal |
|---|---|---|
| CDATA, declaration, or processing instruction with correct terminator | One preserved opaque unresolved record | review required; no automatic mapping |
| Incomplete opaque block at EOF | One preserved opaque unresolved record | refusal before journal/write |
| Adjacent active content after closed opaque block | Active content separately inventoried | reviewed real rows remain usable |
| Delimiter-looking text inside another opaque block/comment/attribute | Remains inside opaque record | never a ledger write target |
| Real table outside a closed opaque block | Normal table mapping | reviewed write succeeds |
| Hidden ten-column ledger table inside opaque block | No accepted live table target | refusal before any register mutation |
